_comment: Does the bot read a page that draws itself, and act on it? page-js.html asks its server for the release's codename after load, and for the rollback deadline only when its Details button is pressed; the server (test/fixtures/page-server.mjs) answers only a request a browser makes itself. Neither value is in the page's source, and curl or web_fetch gets a refusal: only the browse tool, offered in the standing block and run with the agent's shell, can answer.
